name: railyard
description: Lean automatic workflow selection, deliberate model and reasoning effort, native delegation, selected CE delivery, and explicit fleet orchestration.

interface.shortDescription: Deliberate model and effort, lean delivery, and fleet orchestration
interface.longDescription: Railyard supplies a concise startup routing charter and deterministic dispatch checks. Routine work runs natively; selected Compound Engineering workflows own planning, debugging, publishing, and PR follow-through. Model and reasoning effort are chosen together, with Astra Max as a baseline candidate for substantial engineering. Fleet/account placement, targeted review, Oracle, audit, and runtime cleanup remain available when explicitly needed.
defaultPrompt: Use Railyard to complete this change with an appropriate model, effort, and workflow.

Run the Railyard doctor for this installation problem.
